name: fictional-education-progress
asset: Fictional learner progress summaries for a course dashboard
threat: Unauthorized disclosure of learner progress summaries
control: Restrict dashboard access to the learner and assigned instructor; encrypt stored summaries
residual_risk: An authorized instructor could still share a summary outside the course

name: fictional-retail-recommendations
threat: Poisoned customer reviews could distort product recommendations
control: Check review provenance and quarantine suspicious submissions before analysis
residual_risk: Coordinated reviewers may evade the simple provenance checks

name: fictional-health-readmission
asset: Fictional discharge notes used in a readmission planning exercise
threat: A malicious note could inject instructions into a readmission summary
control: Encrypt the notes at rest and restrict access to care staff
residual_risk: An authorized staff member could still act on a malicious note
